newsitem.title: USA: Cooperative extends Triad offer again.
newsitem.headline: Cooperative extends Triad offer again.

text.p: Cooperative Computing Inc and affiliate CCI Acquisition Corp said Tuesday that they have extended the tender offer to acquire the common shares of Triad Systems Corp until 1000 EDT February 27.
The tender offer was scheduled to expire February 19, the companies said.
The terms of the extended offer are identical, at $9.25 per share cash, which was the original offer filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on October 23.

The companies said that they have a pact with the Federal Trade Commission to allow the completion of their previously announced acquisition of Triad and that the FTC should approve the deal by the new deadline.
